h: Phyna reportedly tells Nigerian hookup girls to take their work more seriously
p: Big Brother Naija star Phyna has reportedly called out some women in Nigeria's hookup scene, saying they put less effort into their appearance than their counterparts abroad. Her remarks are drawing mixed reactions online.
more: Phyna says presentation matters if the work is to be treated as a serious job.
Social media users are split, with some backing her and others calling the comments harsh.
